title: The Differential Watchlist: Low-owned assets poised to haul
dek: Five players under 5% ownership with the underlying numbers to justify a look. Rank is won by the players other managers do not have.
body:
## What a differential is for

A differential is not a cheap player or an obscure one. It is a player who moves you *relative to the field*. If 40% of managers own someone, his double-digit haul does not gain you rank — it just stops you losing it. Everything below is under 5% owned.

| Player | Team | Pos | Price | Owned | Mins | xGI | Pts |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| De Cuyper | BHA | DEF | £4.5m | **3.5%** | 77 | 1.68 | 17 |
| Hinshelwood | BHA | MID | £6.0m | **1.1%** | 63 | 1.43 | 16 |
| Nketiah | CRY | FWD | £5.5m | **0.5%** | 55 | 1.18 | 1 |
| Wissa | NEW | FWD | £6.0m | **2.1%** | 90 | 1.02 | 4 |
| Lewis-Potter | BRE | MID | £5.5m | **0.7%** | 90 | 0.89 | 10 |

**De Cuyper** heads the list: 1.68 expected involvements from 77 minutes at 3.5% ownership. At £4.5m he is cheap enough to be a squad-filler rather than a bet you have to justify.

> Under-ownership is a fact about other managers, not a quality in the player. Every name here is under 5% owned for a reason — the question is whether that reason is still true.
source: Generated from ownership under 5% against expected involvements
